summary: Testing of Reseller/Affiliate System for YAMA+ e-commerce platform. Backend tests: 13/16 passed (3 failed due to reseller login API bug). Frontend tests: 12/14 passed (2 flaky due to login timing). Critical bug found: Reseller login endpoint uses undefined SECRET_KEY instead of JWT_SECRET.

issues.description: Reseller login endpoint uses undefined SECRET_KEY and ALGORITHM variables instead of JWT_SECRET and JWT_ALGORITHM. This causes a 500 Internal Server Error when resellers try to login.
issues.reproduction:
1. Create a reseller via admin panel
2. Try to login at /reseller/login with valid credentials
3. Backend returns 500 error due to NameError: name 'SECRET_KEY' is not defined

issues.description: Reseller portal login page logo not loading - the img src '/assets/images/logo_yama_full.png' may have path issues
Admin login redirect timing is variable (5-25 seconds), causing intermittent test failures. Not a bug but affects test reliability.

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: In /app/backend/server.py, change line 10028 from 'SECRET_KEY, algorithm=ALGORITHM' to 'JWT_SECRET, algorithm=JWT_ALGORITHM'
FIX CRITICAL: In /app/backend/server.py, change line 10056 from 'SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[ALGORITHM]' to 'JWT_SECRET, algorithms=[JWT_ALGORITHM]'

context_for_next_testing_agent: Critical bug in reseller login endpoint needs to be fixed first. Once fixed, re-run test_resellers.py::TestResellerPortalAPI tests to verify login works. The admin reseller management and referral code capture features are working correctly. The reseller portal dashboard cannot be tested until login is fixed.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: In server.py, the reseller_login function (line 10005-10046) and get_current_reseller function (line 10048-10070) use undefined variables SECRET_KEY and ALGORITHM instead of the defined JWT_SECRET and JWT_ALGORITHM variables. This is a copy-paste error from another codebase. Fix: Replace SECRET_KEY with JWT_SECRET and ALGORITHM with JWT_ALGORITHM on lines 10028 and 10056.
